question: Would the Commission please inform me whether it is able, following complaint(s) or on its own initiative, to involve itself in cases even where there is only a political agreement concerning a construction project in the country in question and thus no formal political decision has been made (Construction Act passed) in respect of the specific project, for example in the Danish Parliament?

Would the Commission please state whether, and if so when, it can intervene in a planning and construction process in a Member State, for example in the case of the construction of a motorway on route 54 between Næstved and Rønnede in Denmark?

Would the Commission please set out what conditions must apply in order for it to intervene in a motorway project, so as to ensure that construction complies with the EU’s EIA Directive, Habitats Directive, Water Framework Directive and Natura 2000, a case in point being the motorway on route 54 between Næstved and Rønnede in Denmark?
